metadata.description: Every P4 Product Design plugin for Claude, in one marketplace.

plugins.name: design-audit
plugins.description: Audits a Figma design against best practices for its page type and UX laws, returns a prioritized list of user-behavior issues and research recommendations, then adds the notes to Figma.

plugins.name: dev-handoff
plugins.description: Generates a complete dev handoff spec from a Figma design — Requirements and Dev Spec Handoff frames plus native Dev Mode breakpoint annotations, ready for engineers to build from.

plugins.name: figma-to-optimizely
plugins.description: Convert Figma designs into production-ready Optimizely Web Experiment widgets (HTML, CSS, JS, widget.json) with a local preview server.

plugins.name: figma-to-shopify-liquid
plugins.description: Converts a Figma design into a pixel-exact Shopify Liquid section or block, with matching documentation and a static HTML preview.

plugins.name: p4-publisher
plugins.description: Adds a new plugin to the P4 marketplace or publishes an update to an existing one, with every check run before the push.

plugins.name: product-block-gatherer
plugins.description: Gathers and fills product block data for Fortune Shop and NCOA Shop pages, outputting a Product Block Lite and Foundational Product Block as a Word document.

plugins.name: qual-research-simulator
plugins.description: Simulates qualitative user research sessions against a Figma design using data-grounded personas that react independently, like real participants in a usability study.

plugins.name: swolverine-product-photos
plugins.description: Turns raw Swolverine studio shots into website-ready product images: a cut-out on a transparent canvas with the house tone curve and a soft contact shadow. Pixel-accurate, no generative fill.
